logs.page_desc: Monitor system diagnostics, errors, and API requests in real-time. Download complete log files from disk.
logs.clear_logs_confirm: Clear all logs? This cannot be undone.
logs.clear_requests_confirm: Clear all request/response logs? This cannot be undone.
logs.download_empty_hint: This log file is empty (0 bytes) — nothing to download yet.
logs.no_logs: No logs found. Try adjusting your filters.
logs.no_requests: No API requests found. Try adjusting your filters.
logs.attempt_tip: Attempt {{n}} of a request that failed over between models.
logs.budget_exhausted_tip: The failover loop wanted to try another model, but the retry budget refused — too many retries in the last few minutes.
logs.cached_tip: {{n}} of the prompt tokens were served from the provider's prompt cache, which bills them at a reduced rate
logs.tps_tip: Decode throughput once streaming (output tokens over the time after the first token)
logs.max_log_count_hint: Number of log entries to keep in memory. Affects performance and memory usage.
logs.log_level_hint: Controls which log messages are captured by the system.
logs.flush_level_hint: Log messages at this level and above are immediately written to disk.
llm.page_desc: Configure which AI model is used for each task. Each can use a different model and settings.
llm.filter_placeholder: Filter variants by name, model, or provider...
llm.temperature_hint: Lower values make responses more focused and predictable. Higher values make them more creative and varied.
llm.variant_default_desc: Primary model for NPC conversations and any task that doesn't override a variant.
llm.variant_combat_desc: Handles NPC dialogue and reactions during combat encounters.
llm.variant_memory_desc: Processes events into long-term NPC memories with importance scoring.
llm.variant_meta_desc: Quick classification and routing decisions. Uses a fast, cheap model.
llm.variant_decisions_desc: Typed choice questions (NPC mood, who speaks next, who you are addressing) answered with probabilities by a decision model. Its provider must have the Decisions or System One API style (the built-in OpenRouter (Decisions) uses your OpenRouter key). Sampling parameters do not apply. Turn each task on or off under Conversations.
llm.variant_vision_desc: Analyzes screenshots for OmniSight object and scene descriptions.
llm.variant_action_evaluation_desc: Determines which actions NPCs can take in response to events.
llm.variant_CharacterProfileGeneration_d: Generates and updates NPC biographies and personality descriptions.
llm.variant_DiaryGeneration_desc: Writes diary entries summarizing NPC experiences.
llm.variant_AgentDefault_desc: Tool-calling agent for dashboard tasks and automation.
llm.variant_UniversalTranslator_desc: Applies speech pattern rules to transform NPC dialogue style.
llm.variant_gamemaster_evaluation_desc: Evaluates scenes and decides when NPCs should speak or act.
llm.save_preset_desc: Saves the current configuration of all LLM variants as a named preset you can load later.
llm.delete_preset_confirm: Delete the preset "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
llm.export_preset_hint: Download this preset as a YAML file you can share with others.
llm.export_preset_disabled_hint: Built-in presets are already public on the SkyrimNet-GamePlugin repo — no need to export.
llm.import_preset_hint: Add preset YAML files to your model_presets folder. Multi-select supported.
llm.reload_presets_hint: Re-scan the model_presets folder. Use this after dropping in a file by hand.
llm.preset_modified_desc: You are about to modify an official preset. Proceeding will opt you out of automatic model updates. An official preset may be reselected at any time to opt back in.
llm.slot_missing_api_key: {{provider}} has no API key configured. Set one on the Providers page — any rotation slot using {{provider}} will fail at request time.
llm.rotation_hint: Add multiple models to rotate between them for each request. Each model in the rotation can use a different provider and settings. Requests cycle through models in order to increase response variety.
llm.reorder_hint: Drag to reorder. Slot order determines the rotation cycle.
llm.stop_sequences_hint: Comma-separated list of strings that will stop text generation when encountered. Different models recognize different stop tokens (e.g. </s>, <|im_end|>, [INST]).
llm.reasoning_effort_hint: How much the model may think before it answers. Off requests no reasoning; a model that cannot turn it off is retried at minimal automatically. Default leaves the level to the model. Thinking costs time and output tokens, so keep chat models off.
llm.use_structured_outputs_hint: Request structured JSON outputs to enforce response formats. Only supported on certain models / providers, or with LM Studio.
llm.top_p_hint: Nucleus sampling — diversity of token selection
llm.top_k_hint: Limits sampling to K most likely tokens
llm.request_timeout_hint: How long to wait for the model's response before giving up. Reasoning models and long generations (diary, character bio) may need 120s+. Fast chat models usually finish well under 30s.
llm.connect_timeout_hint: How long to wait for the initial TCP connection to the provider's endpoint. Network-level only — does not affect generation time.
llm.max_retries_hint: Number of retry attempts after a transient failure (timeout, 5xx, connection reset). Set to 0 to disable retries — useful when each attempt is slow and expensive.
llm.provider_settings_invalid: Invalid JSON. Must be a JSON object, e.g. {"route": "fallback"}.
llm.rotation_mode_hint: How this rotation picks the model that answers each generation. Sequential takes turns down the list; Random draws a model each time (weighted, if you set weights) so responses stop alternating predictably. Failover order is unaffected.
llm.rot_no_primaries: No enabled primary slots: backups (or, if everything is off, the whole list) will serve as a fallback.
llm.rot_primary_tip: In the rotation: takes its turn answering requests.
llm.rot_backup_tip: Insurance: tried only after the primaries, never leads while one is healthy, and never changes which models take turns.
llm.rot_weight_hint: Relative chance this model leads a generation in Random order. Defaults to 1; higher = more often. 0 keeps the model as failover only.
llm.fateless_privacy_note: Runs on fateless.ai. No API key needed.
llm.fateless_sign_in: Sign in to use Fateless models
tts.page_desc: Select which TTS engine SkyrimNet will use.
tts.max_segment_words.label: Max TTS Segment Words
tts.max_segment_words.desc: Maximum number of words in a single TTS segment. Consecutive sentences are merged without exceeding this word count before being sent to the TTS engine. Set to 0 to always split at every sentence boundary.
tts.max_parallel_hint: Maximum concurrent TTS requests. Higher values improve latency but use more resources.
tts.max_retries_hint: Maximum number of retries on server errors (5xx). 0 = no retries, 1 = one retry (2 total attempts).
tts.auth_token_hint: Bearer authentication token for the server (leave empty if not required).
tts.live_cloning_hint: Use runtime cloning (create/store latents) when setting voice.
tts.enable_audio_tags_hint: Enable paralinguistic tags like [sighs] or [emotion-amusement]. Only works with TTS engines that support this feature.
tts.audio_tags_hint: Enter one item per line. Empty lines will be ignored. Leave empty to allow all tags.
tts.carry_tags.title: Carry-Over Audio Tags
tts.carry_tags.desc: A reply is spoken one sentence at a time, so a tag like [whispers] would only reach its own sentence. These tags carry on to the rest of the reply, until a sentence brings its own. Sounds like [laughs] are left out so they play once. Applies to every engine.
tts.carry_tags.label: Tags
tts.carry_tags.list_desc: One tag per line, as the model writes it inside the brackets. Case does not matter.
tts.voice_fallback_desc: Set backup voices used when the requested one isn't available, with optional per race and gender overrides.
tts.voice_fallback_enabled_hint: Enable automatic fallback to backup voices when the requested voice fails.
tts.race_gender_fallbacks_hint: Fallback voice mappings for specific race/gender combinations.
tts.pronunciation_dictionary_desc: Add word replacements to correct how the TTS engine pronounces specific names or terms.
tts.inworld_temperature_hint: Degree of randomness when sampling audio tokens (0-2). Higher is more expressive.
tts.piper_desc: Fast local voice generation. Requires downloading voice model files.
tts.piper_models_desc: Piper needs voice model files to work. Download the archive below and install it as a regular Skyrim mod through your mod manager (Mod Organizer 2, Vortex, etc.).
tts.piper_models_checking: Checking for installed Piper voice models…
tts.piper_models_installed: {{count}} Piper voice models installed. Ready to use.
tts.piper_preload_hint: Enable automatic preloading of voice models at game startup and cell transitions.
tts.piper_noise_scale_hint: How expressive and emotional voices sound (1.0 = normal, >1.0 = more dramatic, <1.0 = more flat).
tts.piper_noise_w_hint: How natural the rhythm and pacing sounds (1.0 = normal, >1.0 = more varied, <1.0 = more mechanical).
tts.piper_length_scale_hint: Global multiplier for speech rate (1.0 = normal, >1.0 = slower, <1.0 = faster).
tts.piper_speaker_id_hint: Speaker index for multi-speaker Piper models (0-based). Unused for default English models.
tts.pockettts_desc: Built-in voice generation with voice cloning. Works out of the box locally.
tts.pocket_lsd_steps_hint: Latent Solver/Diffusion steps for TTS generation (higher = better quality, slower).
tts.pocket_temperature_hint: Controls randomness in audio generation. Lower = more deterministic, higher = more varied.
tts.pocket_precision_hint: FP32: higher quality, recommended for GPU. INT8: faster on CPU, slightly lower quality.
tts.clone_cache_max_hint: Maximum number of voices to clone. When cloning a voice would take the number above the maximum, the least recently used voice is first deleted. Voices cloned outside of SkyrimNet are counted but never deleted. 0 = unlimited.
tts.xtts_desc: High-quality voice cloning with streaming. Requires a running XTTS server or VastAI.
tts.zonos_desc: Emotion-aware voices that react to in-game moods. Requires a server or VastAI.
tts.chatterbox_desc: Expressive voices with emotion tags. Requires a server.
tts.higgs_desc: High quality Higgs Audio v3 TTS server with emotion and control tag support.
tts.higgs_endpoint_hint: URL of the running Higgs Audio v3 server or Gradio instance.
tts.enable_tag_propagation_hint: Propagate sentence-level control tags ([emotion-*], [style-*], [prosody-*]) across dialogue segments.
tts.openai_compatible_desc: Reusable voice-cloning speech API for Boson.ai Higgs 3 or compatible self-hosted servers, including the SkyrimNet audio.cpp Docker and Windows wrappers.
tts.openai_compatible_endpoint_hint: Base URL of the compatible TTS service.
tts.openai_compatible_api_key_hint: Optional bearer token for authenticated self-hosted services.
tts.openai_compatible_boson_endpoint_hin: The Boson.ai profile uses its fixed Higgs 3 endpoint and model.
tts.openai_compatible_transcribe_missing: Use the active STT service when a reference voice has no transcript. Off sends an empty transcript to self-hosted services.
tts.openai_compatible_higgs_tags_hint: Convert SkyrimNet control tags to Higgs native tokens. Disable this for compatible models that use a different tag syntax.
tts.elevenlabs_desc: High-quality cloud voices with instant voice cloning. Requires an API key.
tts.inworld_desc: Game-focused cloud voices with instant voice cloning. Requires an API key.
tts.zonos_pitch_hint: Standard deviation for pitch variation (higher = more varied pitch).
tts.zonos_rate_hint: Rate of speech generation (lower = slower speech).
tts.zonos_cfg_hint: Classifier-free guidance scale (higher = more adherence to conditioning).
tts.zonos_vq_hint: Vector quantization score (affects audio quality vs speed tradeoff).
tts.zonos_fmax_hint: Maximum frequency for audio generation in Hz.
tts.zonos_dnsmos_hint: Deep Noise Suppression Mean Opinion Score (1-5, higher = better quality).
tts.zonos_denoise_hint: Apply denoising to the speaker reference audio.
tts.zonos_unconditional_keys_hint: List of keys for unconditional generation (one per line).
tts.chatter_exaggeration_hint: How dramatic the emotions are. Higher values produce more expressive speech.
tts.chatter_cfg_hint: Controls the pacing of generated speech.
tts.eleven_stability_hint: Voice stability (0.0-1.0). Higher values make output more consistent.
tts.eleven_similarity_hint: Similarity boost (0.0-1.0). Higher values make output closer to the original voice.
tts.eleven_style_hint: Style exaggeration (0.0-1.0). Higher values make the voice more expressive.
tts.eleven_speaker_boost_hint: Enable speaker boost for better voice clarity.
tts.eleven_request_context_hint: Sends the speaker's earlier lines with each request for consistent delivery. Only on eleven_v4_turbo; requests are then sent one at a time.
tts.eleven_shared_account_hint: Turn on when several SkyrimNet installs use one ElevenLabs account. A voice type another install already cloned is reused instead of cloned over, and player and custom-NPC voices are cloned separately for each install.
tts.eleven_model_id_hint: ElevenLabs model to use for generation (e.g. eleven_v4_turbo, eleven_multilingual_v2).
tts.eleven_streaming_latency_hint: Latency optimization level (0-4). Higher values reduce latency at cost of quality.
tts.eleven_language_code_hint: ISO 639-1 language code (optional, for model enforcement).
tts.create_vastai_hint: Applies the {{preset}} preset and runs smart-create. Find the new instance on the VastAI page.
tts.create_vastai_success: Smart create started — multiple instances are racing for performance. The fastest will be kept and the rest cleaned up automatically.
tts.create_vastai_setup_hint: VastAI isn't configured yet — go to the VastAI page to add an API key, then return here to create an instance.
tts.chatter_voice_sample_rate_hint: Sample rate (Hz) for voice cloning audio upload (16000 = standard/Chatterbox)

chat.label_panel.title: Label outputs
chat.label_panel.empty: Nothing left to label. With Request Recording on, new outputs show up here as you play.
chat.label_panel.keys: Up/Down select · 1-5 rate · N note · Enter take the judge's · A assist on/off (next opening) · Esc close
chat.label_panel.tags_prompt: Why? Pick any · N note · Enter save · Esc back
chat.label_panel.better_prompt: What should have happened? Pick one · N note · Enter save without · Esc back
chat.label_panel.note_keys: Type why · Enter keep the note · Esc drop it
chat.label_panel.note_placeholder: Why was it right or wrong?
chat.label_panel.withheld: Suggestion shown after you rate it
